notes: v669 - the auto-pilot diary was blaming the wrong setting. When it lists where the shares dropped, every stage after the one that emptied also reads 0 - so the advice at the end pointed at the LAST gate in the list, which had never seen a single share. It now names the FIRST gate that went to zero, says how many reached it, and states plainly that changing the settings listed after it will not help. Worth knowing while reading your own diary: the bot's evidence gate and the Today's picks list are graded on DIFFERENT report cards. The bot on 'best proven scan' waits for a SCAN to beat the market on the All scans card; the picks list is built from graded SIGNAL LINES on the Signal card. That is why the picks can be full while the bot stands aside - both are behaving correctly, they are answering different questions. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
